stories.title: AOS configuration control plane modularization
acceptance: One canonical resolver defines effective ticker-config precedence across run-start and profile/read endpoints.

stories.prompt_seed: Modularize AOS and ticker configuration into a DB-first control plane with a canonical resolver/repository while preserving current endpoints and deterministic run-start behavior.
